Šest měsíců, dvakrát týdně. Silová sessi: Six months, twice a week. The strength session A and the resilience session B alternate depending on what the day can carry. Reps and load grow according to how you feel at the end of the session.
Hodnocení tréninku má jen program Runner: Only the Runner's must-have programme has a session rating
Silový trénink snížil výskyt sportovních: Strength training cut sports injuries to less than a third and overuse injuries to about a half (Lauersen et al., 2014), with a larger effect at higher volume and intensity (Lauersen et al., 2018). In endurance runners it improves running economy, best with heavy loads two to three times a week (Blagrove et al., 2018; Rønnestad & Mujika, 2014). Tendons adapt to high loads applied slowly and for longer (Bohm et al., 2015). Progression by how the end of the session felt follows the effort scale and repetitions in reserve (Foster et al., 2001; Helms et al., 2016). Heavy leg strength work impairs hard running over the next 24–48 hours, so session A never comes the day before one (Doma et al., 2017).
Výběr cviků je od trenéra Došlapu, rozdě: The exercise choice comes from a Došlap coach; the phases, rep ranges and progression rules are working assumptions built on the cited principles. The pain rule applies: up to 5 out of 10 during an exercise, settled by the morning.
